english.note: This is the all-purpose everyday way to say that an action or payment is required.

exampleSentences.jyutping: nei5 jat1 ding6 jiu3 gaau1 cin2

english.note: Use this when someone is obliged or required to do something.

exampleSentences.english: You are bound to submit the form today.
exampleSentences.jyutping: nei5 jat1 ding6 jiu3 gam1 jat6 gaau1 fan6 biu2

english.note: Use this when imperative expresses an urgent obligation rather than importance in the abstract.

exampleSentences.english: It is imperative that you call the police immediately.
exampleSentences.jyutping: nei5 jat1 ding6 jiu3 zik1 hak1 bou3 ging2
